You should probably find something to protect yourself with before heading out!
A plain fire attack at one foe in your attack range (2 to 3 tiles to start). Damage is your attack damage, plus or minus 1. Ignores cover. Does 2 more to foes that burn easily. Free.
Attack with your weapon. Damage is your weapon damage, plus or minus 1. Free.
Hit an adjacent foe for 2 less damage and push it 1 tile away. 10% extra crit chance.
A careful shot: 1 more damage than a normal attack and 15% extra crit chance.
Hit a foe for 2 less damage and root it for 1 turn, so it cannot move. 5% extra crit chance.
Moon magic on the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it. Everything there takes 1 less than your spell damage, plus or minus 1. It hurts friends too.
Cover a friend in moonlight: they take 1 less damage from every hit until your next turn.
Fire on the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it. Everything there takes your spell damage, plus or minus 1. It hurts friends too.
Heal a friend, or yourself, for 4 HP plus your magic bonus.
Leap on an adjacent foe for 1 more damage than a normal attack and 10% extra crit chance.
Kick an adjacent foe for 1 less damage and push it 1 tile away. 5% extra crit chance.
Put a foe to sleep. It skips its next turn and cannot fight back. Any damage wakes it at once. Always lands.
A moon wave hits a foe for 3 less than your spell damage and pushes it 2 tiles away. 5% extra crit chance.
Mark a friend: they get 15% extra crit chance until your next turn.
A bolt of fire at one foe for 2 more than your spell damage, plus or minus 1.
Cold hits a foe for 2 less than your spell damage and roots it for 1 turn, so it cannot move. 5% extra crit chance.
Help up a downed friend next to you. They come back with 25% of their max HP.
Knock out a downed party piece next to you. It is out for the rest of this fight.
Bite an adjacent foe for normal damage and slow it: 2 less move for 1 turn.
Taunt: foes that can reach you must attack you, until your next turn.

WHO DRINKS? Click a friend. ESC = cancel.

Stays hidden until a hero comes within 3 tiles. Its first strike from hiding counts as a flank.

Grows 1 ice pillar next to your party, up to 8. A party piece loses 1 HP at the end of its turn for each pillar next to it, at most 2. A pillar has 6 HP and can be broken.
After you move, pick up an adjacent friend, standing or downed, and set them down up to 3 tiles further on.
Give up your action. A friend takes a full extra turn right away, move and action. Once every 3 turns.
Costs your action; a friend takes a full extra turn
Trade places with a friend up to 3 tiles away, even through foes, with no free hits. It uses your move, so you can still act after. Once every 3 turns.
Stay ready: until your next turn, the first foe to move into your bow's reach is stopped and shot once.
Protect a friend: the next hit on them does no damage and has no side effects. Lasts until it is used or your next turn.
Trades places. Uses your move, no free hits
If you do not move, you end your turn on watch: the first foe to walk into your bow's reach is stopped and shot once, until your next turn.
Taunt: foes that can reach you must attack you, until your next turn.
Sweep the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it with your weapon. Every foe there takes your damage, plus or minus 1.
Jump up to 3 tiles in one move, ignoring height.
Hit an adjacent foe for 1 more damage than a normal attack and 20% extra crit chance.
Fire at an area: everything on the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it takes 1 less than your normal damage. It hurts friends too.

Hide a trap on an empty tile 1 to 3 tiles away. The first foe to walk onto it stops there and takes your attack damage plus 2, less its armor; then the trap is gone. It lasts until the start of your next turn. Foes can't see it.
Hit a foe 2 to 4 tiles away for 3 less than your normal damage and pull it 2 tiles toward you. It stops early if something is in the way.
Give up your action: your dog, if within 4 tiles, takes a full extra turn right away, move and action.

Set a line of 2 tiles on fire, starting at a tile 2 to 4 tiles away and running away from you. Everyone standing there, friend or foe, takes your spell damage plus 1 and burns for 3 turns (1 HP at the start of each of their turns, through armor). Nobody can walk onto the burning tiles until the start of your next turn.

Blind every foe on a tile up to 3 tiles away and on the 4 tiles next to it, until the end of their next turn. A blinded foe can only attack what is right next to it, so bows and spells can't attack at all.
Help up a downed friend from up to 3 tiles away. They come back with 25% of their max HP.
Heal a friend for 1 HP plus your magic bonus now, then the same at the start of each of their next 3 turns.
A friend within 3 tiles, or you, can walk again this turn: a full move plus 1 tile.
Scare a foe 2 to 3 tiles away: it hits for 1 less damage during its next turn.
For you and friends within 3 tiles: anyone downed now gets 1 more turn before bleeding out, and anyone who falls before your next turn gets 1 more turn too.
You and friends within 2 tiles hit for 1 more damage for the rest of this turn.
Throw a bomb at the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it. Everything there takes 1 more than your normal damage. It hurts friends too.

Scatter spikes on an empty tile 1 to 3 tiles away. A foe walking onto it stops there, takes 2 less than your normal damage (less its armor) and is slowed: 2 less move for 1 turn. The spikes stay until the start of your next turn.
Heal an adjacent friend for 3 HP.
Throw smoke on a tile 2 to 3 tiles away and the 4 tiles next to it, until the start of your next turn. Nobody can attack from more than 1 tile away into, out of or across the smoke.
Heal an allied foe for 3 HP plus magic bonus.
